the use of a novel, non-invasive, and inexpensive method of lung volume reduction surgery, the unilateral lung volume reduction procedure (ULVRP), in a group of patients with severe, heterogeneous emphysema, results in improved lung function, reduced dyspnea, and increased quality of life.

the use of a single lung ventilation strategy in patients with emphysema and unilateral lung disease is safe, and that the results are similar to those obtained in patients with em- physema and bilateral disease.
